text: Notice of Fee Adjustment. Pursuant to Section 4(b) of the Residents' Agreement, the monthly service fee shall increase by 8% with effect from 1 March. Residents who wish to contest the adjustment must submit a written objection to the Estates Office no later than 14 February. Objections received after that date will not be considered. Payment of the adjusted fee is required regardless of any pending objection. The Estates Office may waive the adjustment in exceptional circumstances, as determined at its sole discretion.

raw.summary: This notice informs residents that their monthly service fee is going up by 8%. This change will start on March 1st. If a resident disagrees with this fee increase, they have a deadline to submit a formal written objection to the Estates Office. Even if an objection is filed, the new, higher fee must still be paid.
key_points: Monthly service fees will increase by 8%.
The fee increase takes effect on March 1st.
Residents can formally object to the fee change.
Objections must be submitted in writing to the Estates Office.
Payment of the adjusted fee is mandatory even if an objection is pending.

text: By continuing to use the Service you agree to these Terms. We may change the Terms at any time by posting an update, and your continued use means you accept the changes. You must be at least 16 years old to create an account. You must keep your password confidential. We may suspend your account if we believe, acting reasonably, that you have breached these Terms. Refunds for annual plans are available within 30 days of purchase. Unused credits expire after a period determined by us.
